title: Multi-layer editing: selected layer state, render all layers
description: Everything edits layer 0 only: Shell has no selected-layer state — every mutation and derived stage array hardcodes timeline.layers[0] (Shell.tsx:367,446,455,477,558,725-778,836), and Timeline F5/F6/F7 shortcuts act on layers[0] regardless of the clicked layer (Timeline.tsx:492). Content on any other layer can be neither created, edited, nor rendered. Add active-layer selection (Timeline highlights it), route all stage edits to it, render ALL layers in correct z-order respecting visibility/lock flags (StageArea flattens into one synthetic layer ignoring both, StageArea.tsx:1276-1287). Note the layer-order contract conflict: model addLayer prepends (index 0 = top) while CanvasRenderer draws layers[0] first (= bottom) — packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts:88-96 vs engine/renderer.ts:529-535; pick one contract, ship a shared Timeline-to-SceneGraph converter in core, and use it in stage, test-movie, and SWF compile. See docs/02.
